- Recognize that with equal speeds and infinite-line symmetry, every left-to-right car will encounter every right-to-left car exactly once as they pass through each other; collisions are counted as pairwise encounters between opposite directions.
- Therefore, the total number of collisions is simply n * n (each of the n cars from one side meets each of the n cars from the other side once).
- Implement by validating n is non-negative integer (optionally), then return n * n as an integer.
